'''Tannon Praji's mother''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]. She was the mother of [[Griff Praji]], [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]] and [[Tannon Praji's brother|his brother]].

==Biography==
Tannon Praji's mother was born years before [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]] to the influential [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She always wanted to instill in her sons an appreciation for fine arts and culture, but did not want to limit them to what the capital had to offer. As a result, her entire family took repeated vacations offworld to such places as the museums of [[Porus Vida]], and the [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] ruins of the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]].
